description: Create and manage docs plus Notion-style databases, boards, structured intake forms, and request records through Content, including repo-backed Markdown/MDX.

auth.setup: Use the Content actions if they are already available. Otherwise add https://content.agent-native.com/mcp as a remote MCP connector in Claude or Claude Cowork, Claude Code, ChatGPT or OpenAI, Codex, Grok or xAI, or another MCP host, then complete the host-owned OAuth sign-in. Use /mcp/connect only as the browser-authorized fallback for clients without remote OAuth. Local File Mode requires a local Content app, Agent-Native Desktop, or another trusted local bridge for filesystem access.
